lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 distinct white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section but becomes tighter and less defined toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the third vertical line from the anterior, splitting near the dorsal ridge. A second minor split is visible on the fifth line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line and the final three posterior lines terminate mid-flank before reaching the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two distinct high-contrast white spots are located on the lateral haunch, immediately superior to the transition to the orange-tan lower limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate trajectory, sweeping outward and backward from the frontal bone before curving inward and upward toward the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 2.8 times the combined width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 15 percent of the total horn length visible above the ridge texture.

other_distinctive_markers: A Red-billed Oxpecker (Buphagus erythrorhynchus) is present on the upper-mid dorsal region of the torso.
